clue.text: Picture of Nora with parents either side?

indicators.note: the parents stand one on each side of the name, so it sits inside them

parts.note: PA and MA are familiar words for father and mother, split to flank the name

explanation.surface: A family photo of a girl called Nora flanked by her mother and father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parents' supplies two pieces at once: PA before NORA and MA after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A panorama is a wide, sweeping view or image, so it can be called a picture.

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a strip worn round the waist
third meaning: an area or region

explanation.walkthrough: Three separate meanings of one short word sit side by side; the surface suggests a hit record from a band.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a hard blow, a strap round the waist, and a stretch of territory such as a green belt.

parts.note: RE means regarding or concerning, as in business letters
a peal is the ringing of bells

explanation.surface: A cancellation of something that concerns a ring, perhaps a broken engagement.
explanation.definitionFit: Repeal is the revoking of a law, so it is a cancellation or annulment.

clue.text: Drink in Irish county town at first

parts.note: Clare is a county on the west coast of Ireland

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word town is wanted here

explanation.surface: Having a drink in an Irish county town at the start of an evening.
explanation.walkthrough: CLARE is a county in the west of Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is red wine from Bordeaux, a classic alcoholic beverage.

clue.text: Border less friendly when North's overridden South?

indicators.note: the north letter takes over the place of the south letter, overriding it

parts.note: frostier means colder in manner, less friendly
S is the compass abbreviation for south
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: A border that turns hostile when northerners overrule southerners.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the S in FROSTIER for N.
explanation.definitionFit: A frontier is the boundary line between two countries.

indicators.note: taking every other letter, at regular intervals, of the word insulted

explanation.surface: A man being insulted again and again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is not a person here but the Isle of Man in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man is an island, and an isle is a small island.

parts.note: to fare is to get on or manage, as in how did you fare
a well is a deep source, as in a well of knowledge

explanation.surface: Coping with an abundant water source in a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vale' looks like a valley but is the Latin word for goodbye; the question mark flags the trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Vale is the Latin parting word, a goodbye, used in English for a valediction.

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist
SH is the call for silence

explanation.surface: Telling an impetuous painter to stop talking.
explanation.definitionFit: A rash decision is made too quickly, without due thought.

clue.text: Formal wear in front section — a draw

parts.note: the bow is the front part of a ship
a tie is a drawn match

explanation.surface: Formal clothing worn at the front of a match that ended level.
explanation.definitionFit: A bow tie is worn with a dinner jacket at black-tie events, a piece of evening dress.

clue.text: Moved fast, gazelle? Extremely — in large open area

parts.note: ran means moved quickly

indicators.note: only the outermost letters of the word gazelle are wanted

explanation.surface: A gazelle sprinting across wide open grassland.
explanation.definitionFit: A range is a large stretch of open grazing land, as in the American West.

clue.text: Impossible to get to this in court

definitions.text: Impossible to get to this in court

parts.words: Impossible to get to this in court
parts.note: court here is a tennis court: a serve the receiver cannot even touch

explanation.walkthrough: 'court' suggests a law court, but it is a tennis court and the serve that cannot be returned.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis an unreturnable serve that the opponent fails to touch is called by this word.

clue.text: Group of soldiers to some extent flip at rollicking

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Soldiers who are partly flippant at a boisterous party.
explanation.definitionFit: A patrol is a small detachment of troops sent out on a mission.

parts.note: a roll is a list of names, as in roll call
over means ended

explanation.surface: The list of winners is complete and the unclaimed prize passes to the next draw.
explanation.walkthrough: In a lottery, a rollover is a jackpot nobody won, added to the next draw.
explanation.definitionFit: A lottery jackpot left unwon and added to the following draw's prize is called this.

clue.text: After time fix stand for cooking

indicators.note: the fixing word comes after the time letter

parts.note: to rivet is to fasten firmly

explanation.surface: After a while, mending a stand used in the kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: A trivet is a three-legged metal support for a pot over a fire or on a table.

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife
a miner works down a pit

explanation.surface: An inspector who used to work down the mines.
explanation.definitionFit: An examiner checks or scrutinises something, as an inspector does.

clue.text: Computer program including everything for vote

indicators.note: the program word takes the everything word inside it

parts.note: a bot is an automated software program
all means everything

explanation.surface: Software that counts every vote cast.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballot is a secret vote, or the paper on which it is recorded.

indicators.note: the buyer word holds the new letter fast inside it

parts.note: a taker is someone willing to buy, as in any takers

explanation.surface: A willing purchaser closing a deal on a brand-new vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A tanker is a ship built to carry oil or other liquid in bulk.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a flow of water
second meaning: a class of pupils grouped by ability

explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' reads as an adjective meaning present-day, but it is a noun for flowing water.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a flowing river and a set of school pupils of similar ability taught together.

indicators.note: the letters of streak come out in a surprising new order

explanation.surface: A surprise run of good form for an athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who skates, on ice or a board, competes in a sport.

indicators.note: the letters needed are tucked away inside the word embarkation

explanation.surface: A boat taken for boarding passengers.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's ark was a great boat, so the word means a ship or vessel.

clue.text: Initially feels resentment over woman's nasty show of dislike

indicators.note: take the opening letter of each of the next five words

explanation.surface: Someone feels resentment at a woman's nasty behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: A frown is a furrowing of the brow expressing displeasure or disapproval.

indicators.note: life has gone awry, so its letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Papers that show a life gone off the rails.
explanation.definitionFit: A file is a folder or collection of papers, so it can stand for documents.

indicators.note: the trouble word is placed after the silly word, so it comes second

parts.note: an ass is a fool, a silly
to ail is to trouble or afflict

explanation.surface: A problem arising from a foolish assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after' puts the trouble word second; 'silly' is a noun here, as in 'you silly'.
explanation.definitionFit: To assail is to assault or set upon violently.

parts.note: kit is equipment, like fishing tackle

explanation.surface: A society takes on a satirical sketch.
explanation.definitionFit: A skit is a short comic piece that mocks its subject.

indicators.note: the prompt word welcomes the learner letter inside it

parts.note: a cue is a prompt to an actor
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A prompt to greet a beginner with a helpful tip.
explanation.walkthrough: L comes from the L-plate a learner driver displays in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A clue is a piece of information that points towards a solution.

clue.text: Cosmetic I picked up joining ship

indicators.note: picked up means heard, so the letter I is replaced by a word sounding the same

parts.note: the letter I is said aloud
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: Someone collecting cosmetics as they board a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyeliner is make-up drawn along the lash line.
